title: Reinforcement-learning baseline comparison at 100-SKU scale (10 seeds). Total cost normalized to BL1 per seed. Constraint viol. is fraction of decision epochs where the unconstrained policy proposed a joint order violating budget/capacity prior to governance projection.
interpretation: BL4 (per-SKU DQN) lacks cross-SKU coordination and violates joint constraints frequently. BL5 (MAPPO) closes most of the aggregate-cost gap but still incurs constraint violations requiring external clipping. AAIRM's governance layer guarantees feasibility by construction (0% violation) and anchors each decision in the ledger.
